description: DUT discards a TCP packet with Data Offset < 5 (RFC 793 §3.1 — header alone is 20 bytes = 5 32-bit words)
approach:
[Objective]
Data Offset < 5 means the declared header length is shorter than the minimum 20 bytes — impossible. DUT must drop without ack.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: data with Data Offset < 5.
3. Observation: DUT must NOT ack the malformed data.

[Pass condition]
No DUT ACK to invalid Data Offset.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_unexpected_ack — DUT acked malformed segment

verdicts.Pass: DUT discarded segment with Data Offset < 5 — normal
verdicts.Fail_unexpected_ack: DUT acked segment with invalid Data Offset
